topic: remove painter's tape without peeling the fresh paint
core_question: How do you take painter's tape off a wall without pulling the paint with it? (secondary: How do I safely remove jammed paper from inside a printer?)
answer_summary: Score along the tape's edge with a utility knife to break the paint film, then peel the tape back slowly at roughly a 45-degree angle, ideally before the paint fully cures.; after the topic shift: Power off, open all access panels/trays, and slowly pull the jammed sheet in the direction of the paper path (not backward) to avoid tearing it.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; texting quickly with typos here and there
